name: task-detail-panel
title: Task Detail Panel
description: An agent task's goal, acceptance and evidence, dependencies that select their task, the pending decision with proposal actions, usage and the attempt timeline. TaskDetailPanel shows it as a non-modal panel; TaskDetailDialog as a modal dialog or a right-side drawer. Escape and a close button close either.

files.content:
"use client" import { useId, type ComponentProps, type KeyboardEvent } from "react" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { agentTaskBoardLabels } from "@/components/ui/agent-task-labels" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { TaskDetailContent, TaskDetailMeta, type TaskDetailContentProps } from "@/components/ui/task-detail-content" import { CloseIcon, insidePopup } from "@/components/ui/task-detail-parts" type CloseReason = "close-press" | "escape-key" | "outside-press" type TaskDetailPanelProps = Omit, "children"> & Omit & { onClose?: (reason: CloseReason) => void /** Heading level of the task title; sections inside take the next one. */ headingLevel?: 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 } function TaskDetailPanel({ task, mode, now, locale, timeZone, formatCurrency, labels = agentTaskBoardLabels, onApproveProposal, onRejectProposal, agentApproval, onSelectTask, canSelect, onClose, renderThreadLink, onOpenThread, renderLink, onOpenLink, renderAttachments, renderLocation, agentAvatars, statusTones, headingLevel = 2, className, onKeyDown, ...props }: TaskDetailPanelProps) { const titleId = useId() const Title = `h${headingLevel}` as "h2" const content = { task, mode, now, locale, timeZone, formatCurrency, labels, onApproveProposal, onRejectProposal, agentApproval, onSelectTask, canSelect, renderThreadLink, onOpenThread, renderLink, onOpenLink, renderAttachments, renderLocation, agentAvatars, statusTones, } function handleKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) { onKeyDown?.(event) if (event.key !== "Escape" || event.defaultPrevented || !onClose) return if (insidePopup(event.target, event.currentTarget)) return event.preventDefault() onClose("escape-key") } return ( // Escape anywhere inside the non-modal panel closes it, as it would a dialog; the handler only listens to bubbling keys. // oxlint-disable-next-line jsx-a11y/no-noninteractive-element-interactions
{task.title}
{onClose && ( )}
) } export { TaskDetailPanel } export type { CloseReason, TaskDetailPanelProps }
